firmware.title: Wolfenstein 3D
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; Wolf4SDL
firmware.description: Wolfenstein 3D on Wolf4SDL, with OPL2 music and digitised sound. Plays the full or shareware data from the SD card.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard and mouse, NES pad: arrows, Ctrl: fire, Space: open, Alt: strafe.
